# occlusal
- circular outline
- prominent [[#buccal surface|buccal]] cusp
	- look how tall/big it is
- well-developed marginal [[Ridges]] connected by transverse ridge
	- looks like a central groove

**![](data:image/png;base64,)** where is the prominence pointing to? up the right then left
**![](data:image/png;base64,)** up the left then right
# snake eyes
- pit like buccal depressions on occlusal

# lingual cusp
- lingual inclination of lingual cusp
- non functional

# cusps
- 2
- buccal > lingual

# ridges
- buccal triangular ridge of lingual cusp runs from lingual cusp tip
	- towards buccal
- transverse ridge may or may not be present

# resembles primary maxillary first molar
# buccal surface
- cusp surface sloping [[#lingual|lingually]]
	- this is way more visual on other views
- [[#mesial]] cusp slope shorter than [[#distal]]

# lingual
- characteristically ==poorly developed== 
- appears to have **==cingulum like appearance**

# mesial
- **==quadrilateral shape==**
- notable ==bulbous== convexity
	- especially for mesial

![[Pasted image 20260329233557.png]]

# distal
- same as [[#mesial]]
- quadrilateral
- bulbous convexity but less extreme than M

![[Pasted image 20260329233717.png]]


# root
- single root
- **==vertical depression with two canals==**
- rarely bifurcation
	- split
